source:
Most-viewed: 2000 - 2009
#1 T-mac's 13 points in 33 seconds (Dec 9, 2004 - 27M views)
#2 Kobe scores 81 (Jan 22, 2006 - 22M views)
#3 Jordan ball fakes (Apr 7, 2003 – 9.4M views)
#4 Fisher's 0.4 second game-winner (May 13, 2004 – 7.8M views)
#5 Iverson steps over Lue (Jun 6, 2001 – 6M views)
claim: The five most-viewed 2000s moments by aggregated views are Tracy McGrady scoring 13 points in 33 seconds (27,179,256), Kobe's 81-point game (21,625,200), Jordan's ball fake (9,377,700), Derek Fisher's 0.4-second game-winner (7,822,632) and Allen Iverson stepping over Tyronn Lue (6,029,208).

source:

#1 Jordan's last 3 minutes as a Bull (Jun 14, 1998 - 35M views)

claim: The five most-viewed 1990s moments by aggregated views are Jordan's last 3 minutes as a Bull (34,843,786), Jordan blocking Shaq in their first meeting (11,990,355), Shaq bringing down the backboard (10,604,507), Jordan's eyes-closed free-throw (6,491,582) and Jordan's Flu Game (6,475,361).

source:
Most-viewed: 1980 - 1989
#1 The Shot (May 7, 1989 - 5.8M views)
#2 Jordan scores 63 (Apr 20, 1986 - 3.2M views)
#3 Bird steals pass for game-winner (May 26, 1987 – 2M views)
#4 Bird scores 60 vs. Hawks (Mar 12, 1985 – 1.8M views)

claim: The five most-viewed 1980s moments by aggregated views are The Shot by Jordan (5,756,462), Jordan scoring 63 in his first playoffs (3,178,044), Bird stealing the pass for a game-winner (1,958,433), Bird scoring 60 against the Hawks (1,780,790) and Jordan's first 40-point game (1,186,732).

source: It has more views than any other NBA moment in our dataset (i.e., it's #1, all-time, at 35M views).
claim: The most-viewed moment in the whole dataset is Jordan's last 3 minutes as a Bull, with 34,843,786 aggregated views.

source: And we're very disappointed to see Reggie's 8 points in 9 seconds outside the top 5 (it's #6).
claim: Reggie Miller's 8 points in 9 seconds ranks sixth among the 1990s moments by aggregated views, with 5,155,258.
code: c[c.decade == 1990].nlargest(100, 'agg_view_count').reset_index(drop=True).assign(rank=lambda d: d.index + 1).loc[lambda d: d.title_custom.str.contains('8 points in 9 seconds', case=False, na=False), ['rank', 'title_custom', 'agg_view_count']]

source: More than half of the plays are Jordan highlights.
claim: Jordan is named in 52 of the 100 most-viewed 1990s moments' labels, more than half.

source: It's criminal that there's only one Ewing highlight, and it's him on the receiving end of a Jordan dunk
claim: Exactly one of the 100 most-viewed 1990s moments is an Ewing highlight: "Jordan dunks on Ewing", with 1,305,645 aggregated views.
code: c[c.decade == 1990].nlargest(100, 'agg_view_count').assign(Ewing=lambda d: d.title_custom.str.contains('Ewing', case=False, na=False), ewing_count=lambda d: d.title_custom.str.contains('Ewing', case=False, na=False).sum(), total=lambda d: len(d)).loc[lambda d: d.Ewing, ['title_custom', 'agg_view_count', 'ewing_count', 'total']]

source: Unsurprisingly, 3 of the top 5 are Jordan.
claim: Three of the five most-viewed 1980s moments are Jordan highlights.

source: They pointed to moments such as Ralph Sampson's game-winner (#26), Tree Bites Man (#31), or The Sleepy Floyd Game (#42), not Jordan's first 40-point game (#5).
claim: In the 1980s ranking, Jordan's first 40-point game is 5th, Ralph Sampson's game-winner is 26th, Tree Bites Man is 31st and The Sleepy Floyd Game is 42nd.

source: We barely found any videos in our top 100 from pre-Jordan era (‘80 - ‘84).
claim: The oldest of the 100 most-viewed moments across all decades is from March 12, 1985; none predates 1985.
